riskiest_assumption_test.assumption: Indian govt-exam aspirants will PAY (INR 199/yr for verified, eligibility-filtered, quiet alerts — or INR 39 per application for 'application-ready' help) for something they currently get free from Telegram, Testbook/Adda247 and Sarkari Result sites.

experiment.type: WTP fake-door with real UPI payment (behavioral), seeded through aspirant communities
experiment.description: Build in 2-3 days a Hindi+English mobile landing page with a working eligibility checker (DOB, qualification, category, state -> list of currently open/upcoming central + one state's exams with official links; data hand-curated for the next 60 days). After the result screen, show two offers: (A) 'Pro alerts on WhatsApp — only exams you're eligible for, every alert linked to the official PDF, no ads, no sales calls — INR 199/year' and (B) 'Application-ready kit for <current big exam, e.g., RRB/SSC> — document checklist, photo/signature resized to spec, fee & last-date reminders — INR 39'. Both buttons go to a real UPI/Razorpay payment page (refund promised if not delivered; deliver B manually as a concierge). Traffic: post the free checker in 20-30 Hindi-belt aspirant Telegram/WhatsApp groups (with admin permission) + up to INR 4,000 Meta ads to 18-30-year-olds in 2-3 Hindi-belt states. Track: checker completions, WhatsApp opt-ins, pay-click rate, actual payments.
experiment.estimated_cost: ~INR 5,000-8,000 (~$60-90): INR 4,000 ads, ~INR 1,000 domain/hosting/payment fees, rest buffer. Founder time ~25 hours.
experiment.pass_threshold: From >= 300 completed eligibility checks within 14 days: >= 3% click a paid offer AND >= 10 completed UPI payments in total (A+B), AND >= 25% of completers opt in to free WhatsApp alerts. All three must hold.

all_assumptions_ranked.assumption: Users will pay for anything beyond free alerts (INR 199/yr Pro or INR 39/application)
Eligibility-filtered, trust-first alerts are preferred enough over Telegram/Testbook/Adda247 to install and keep
A no-audience solo builder can acquire aspirants via Telegram seeding + long-tail ASO at <= INR 5/install
Users keep notifications enabled and open >= 3x/month between exam events
Solo founder can keep a multi-board (central + state) notification and eligibility-rules database accurate and timely, in Hindi
Aspirants genuinely miss deadlines / feel the pain of noisy alerts
